adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `evt.destinationCalendar` can contain multiple calendars for COLLECTIVE team events (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` in `handleNewBooking.ts`), but when persisting the booking it only connects the first one: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (no persistence of the rest). Later, `confirm.handler.ts` rebuilds `evt.destinationCalendar` solely from `booking.destinationCalendar` (singular) or `user.destinationCalendar`, wrapping it into a single-element array. Since `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now creates events per `event.destinationCalendar` entry, a deferred/confirmation flow will only have that one persisted destination calendar available, so additional hosts’ calendars from `teamDestinationCalendars` can’t be recreated at confirmation time.
